gems.title: 你能看到一切
gems.summary: 在被判入狱前的34天，臭名昭著的硅谷创始人伊丽莎白·霍姆斯邀请了一支持怀疑态度的摄制组记录她的一举一动。起初这是一部关于神秘罪犯的私密肖像，却演变成一场持续3年、坠入深渊的迷幻之旅。
gems.summaryEn: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enig
gems.whyWatch: 以纪录片形式贴身记录霍姆斯入狱前34天，荒诞与真实交织，兼具话题性和窥视感。
gems.whyWatchEn: An intimate, absurd and chilling pre-prison portrait of Elizabeth Holmes, blending true-crime access with unsettling charisma.
gems.audience: 真实罪案纪录片爱好者、科技与商业丑闻关注者
gems.audienceEn: True-crime documentary fans; viewers interested in tech and business scandals

gems.title: 黑球
gems.summary: 三个同性恋男子在西班牙历史上1932 年、1937 年和 2017 年三个不同时期的故事。
gems.summaryEn: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.
gems.whyWatch: 跨越1932、1937、2017三个时代的西班牙同性恋群像，历史创伤与个体命运交织，题材罕见。
gems.whyWatchEn: A rare three-era Spanish drama tracing gay lives across 1932, 1937 and 2017, weaving historical trauma with intimate destinies.
gems.audience: 历史剧情片、LGBTQ+题材与欧洲作者电影观众
gems.audienceEn: Historical drama fans; LGBTQ+ cinema and European arthouse audiences

gems.title: 泥面人
gems.summary: 好莱坞新星马特·哈根遭犯罪头目毁容后，为恢复容貌接受先进治疗，却意外陷入疯狂，走上复仇之路。
gems.summaryEn: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothi
gems.whyWatch: 毁容演员堕入疯狂的科幻恐怖复仇故事，反派起源设定新鲜，类型混搭有记忆点。
gems.whyWatchEn: A disfigured actor's descent into sci-fi horror madness and revenge, with a fresh villain-origin hook and memorable genre mixing.
gems.audience: 恐怖/科幻类型片爱好者、反派起源故事粉丝
gems.audienceEn: Horror and sci-fi genre fans; villain-origin story enthusiasts

gems.title: 登峰传奇：丹增诺盖
gems.summary: 根据真实事件改编。喜马拉雅登山家丹增·诺盖与新西兰登山家埃德蒙·希拉里携手登顶珠穆朗玛峰，成为首批登顶者。在妻子达瓦和探险队秘书吉尔·亨德森的支持下，丹增争取加入英国登山队，在攀登过程中面对文化差异、阶级矛盾与高山险境。
gems.summaryEn: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.
gems.whyWatch: 从丹增·诺盖视角重述珠峰首登，文化差异与登山史诗并重，真实历史题材有厚度。
gems.whyWatchEn: Retells the first Everest ascent from Tenzing Norgay's perspective, balancing cultural friction with mountaineering epic and historical weight.
gems.audience: 传记片、登山题材与真实历史故事观众
gems.audienceEn: Biopic fans; mountaineering and true-history audiences

gems.title: 忘却之岛
gems.summary: 一对好友乔和拉伊萨在高中毕业后要分开了，她们准备吃垃圾食品、唱卡拉ok度过在一起的最后一夜，却被一个神奇的传送通道送去了一座被遗忘已久的奇幻岛屿——纳卡利，当她们得知，想要重返家园，代价竟是抹去两人关于这段友谊的所有记忆时，乔和拉伊萨必须争分夺秒，在彻底忘记彼此之前找到离开这座岛屿的方法。
gems.summaryEn: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they d
gems.whyWatch: 少女友谊撞上奇幻遗忘岛，以“记忆代价”驱动冒险，动画设定清新又带情感后劲。
gems.whyWatchEn: A girlhood friendship collides with a fantasy island of forgetting, powered by a memory-cost premise that is fresh and emotionally resonant.
gems.audience: 动画奇幻爱好者、青少年成长故事观众、家庭观影
gems.audienceEn: Animation and fantasy fans; coming-of-age audiences; family viewers

gems.title: 侠探杰克
gems.summary: 退役宪兵杰克·雷彻独自游走各地，凭借敏锐头脑与强悍身手追查案件，在一次次危机中揭开隐藏于罪案背后的阴谋。
gems.summaryEn: 退役宪兵杰克·雷彻独自游走各地，凭借敏锐头脑与强悍身手追查案件，在一次次危机中揭开隐藏于罪案背后的阴谋。
gems.whyWatch: 硬汉游侠式破案，节奏利落、动作扎实，适合喜欢独立单元罪案与强主角魅力的观众。
gems.whyWatchEn: A hard-boiled drifter-solving-cases crime series with brisk pacing, grounded action and strong lead charisma.
gems.audience: 犯罪动作剧迷、硬汉侦探与单元破案爱好者
gems.audienceEn: Crime-action fans; hard-boiled detective and procedural viewers

gems.title: 魔女嘉莉
gems.summary: 父亲的突然离世迫使嘉莉进入到了残酷的公立高中，她不得不面对席卷社区的校园霸凌丑闻、社交媒体时代无情的压力和冷酷无情，以及伴随青春期而觉醒的神秘心灵感应能力。
gems.summaryEn: 父亲的突然离世迫使嘉莉进入到了残酷的公立高中，她不得不面对席卷社区的校园霸凌丑闻、社交媒体时代无情的压力和冷酷无情，以及伴随青春期而觉醒的神秘心灵感应能力。
gems.whyWatch: 将经典故事重构进校园霸凌与社交媒体时代，神秘心理能力与青春残酷并置，新鲜且有议题性。
gems.whyWatchEn: Reimagines the classic tale inside bullying and social-media culture, pairing telekinetic mystery with brutal adolescence for a fresh, topical take.
gems.audience: 青春悬疑剧、经典改编与超自然题材观众
gems.audienceEn: Teen mystery fans; classic-adaptation and supernatural audiences

gems.whyWatch: 中年转行当警察的设定自带反差与幽默，案件节奏轻快，在警匪剧中保留温度和省思。
gems.whyWatchEn: A middle-aged rookie cop premise brings built-in contrast and humor, with brisk cases and warmth beneath the procedural surface.
